note: The Oct 22 reset was made with Q3 in hand and the stock has sat 17 points below XLV since with shorts shrinking, so a formalised flat-EBITDA guide clears a low bar; the open Colombia review and a stale $0.27 EPS headline keep it small.

Rests on the expectations item: 52-week low, -45% since quarter end, balanced skew and call-heavy OI with the quarter effectively pre-released, against the real risk that the FY SS&O range goes to the low end on BTC.

A first FY27 guide from a new CEO after three cuts, measured against a street at +25% EPS, into a stock that ran 15% in 20 days; the guide line has moved this name double digits and 6 of 7 prints fell, with the SMPL template and rising shorts the offsets.

The Oct 27 6-K pins a strong Q3 (AUM back at the Q4'25 level, marks reversed) on a stock at 0.97x book with a $40M buyback, but the window return is mostly BTC beta and Q4-to-date is visibly weaker, so the lean is small.

The first FY27 guide meets a street still at +3% while handset and PC units fell ~20% in the quarter (Qualcomm, IDC) and Dolby guides Q1 low by habit; the 6% slide on volume, call-bid skew and a Q4 beat on the Meta deal take most of that out.

The Oct 9 reaffirmation after the quarter closed is a document that argues for a held guide, but the Nov 13 EGM for a 4x share ceiling with a going-concern flag and a first Sept-30 cash figure makes the raise the line this thin ADS trades on, and its only prior print was sold.

The quarter is pre-released in the 10-Q, so the call is about funding a -$26M run-rate business from $15.6M of cash with a $7M bridge and a record of 20%+ discounted raises; the 60% slide prices the direction, not the form or size of the raise.

A beat of the guide top is the base case and has been sold 3 of the last 4 times; Shopify's international GMV slowed and the street's Q4 ($472M) already sits above what a flow-through raise implies ($467M), so the likely raise still lands under the bar, with the put-bid skew and 5% give-back the only offsets.

A $4M market cap at roughly half of estimated cash, with the chairman's RSUs conditioned on a $6.5M financing and a reverse-split vote the next day, makes a raise or going-concern language the likely print-day content; the discount to cash and the release-day pop habit are the offsets.

A 26% rebound off the September low against a falling software tape, with shorts already covering, raises the bar for a first FY27 guide that management pre-set at mid-single digits; three of the last four guide-touching prints fell and utilities services were still weak into Q4.

Theater attendance (Cinemark +12.7%, AMC +23%) against last year's theater-driven beverage decline argues revenue clears ~$400M, but a +14.6% month with no news at 34.5x and a record September diesel print offset it; the findings cancel to zero.

This name trades on the breakeven timeline, which was reaffirmed with no walk-back and funded by the August raise, while the stock sits at a 52-week low below the $5.52 placement price with balanced skew; the -39% Africa phone quarter puts the GMV range at risk, but the August precedent (GMV cut, EBITDA held, +10%) says that is tolerated.

Gildan, the blank supplier to Kornit's screen-printer customers, cut FY by ~$600M on Nov 5 and said softness persists into Q4, while the street's Q4 ($62.4M) is still management's August frame and Kornit guides quarters conservatively; a first Q4 range under $62M repeats last November's -6%.

Home Depot's +2.2% comp this morning against a LOW bar of ~flat is the best counterparty read on the day, but LOW ran 8 points over XHB into the print and HD itself was sold on margin, so the net is a small positive on a 3.4% implied move.

The Q3 guide carries the acquisition lap, the casegoods exit and plant friction against a street at flat EPS, Q1 missed its own range, and Havertys' written comps collapsed in the same window; the +13.9 put skew says the market already leans this way, which keeps the size inside the implied move.

Down 51% since Q2 against -35% for WeRide, at the low with calls bid and a robotaxi target management has said it will exceed, with Hesai confirming Q3 robotaxi lidar demand; the founder lock-up expiry that drove the last two sessions is the dated overhang that caps it.

The Nov 5 restatement of $220-230M with October in hand is a document that removes the consensus-miss pattern (consensus now sits at the guide's low end), on a stock down 17% with no news; the silence on any month beating July's $20.9M is the reason it is not larger.

A Q4 price outlook 15-25% below Q3 is the likely guide and Q4 street estimates have not caught up, but the stock has fallen 10% since Albemarle's identical cut was bought, sits at the low, and has risen on each of its last three prints on volume commentary; close to a non-result.

Holding the ex-refund range mechanically lifts a street FY ($8.43) that sits below the guide midpoint ($8.75), and the stock has not run against XRT, but the whisper is 7% over consensus, Mattel flagged a late-Q3 POS slowdown into the holiday and 5 of 8 prints fell, so the net is small.

A 47% unexplained slide in a thin ADS to roughly net cash is not evidence of over-reaction, management did not reassure during it, the +15% bounce into the print has taken the easy relief, and the one line this name has moved on (margin) has no evidence either way; the findings offset to zero.
